name: Arctosaur
ability: Water Absorb / Ice Body / Slush Rush (hidden)
look: a plesiosaur with a shark's head: a deep-blue toothy head, a long body of pale icy shell plates, a tall dorsal fin and four white-tipped paddle flippers
entry: The Fossilized Dino's true owner: a long-necked sea reptile with a shark's head. It hunted beneath the ice of ancient seas and could freeze the water round its prey solid.
how: Put a Arctozolt or Arctovish in a CobbleEffort: Distortion DNA machine with a DNA Analyzer and a DNA Purifier beside it, pick Arctosaur at the Purifier and purify it (it keeps its level, nature and moves).
